imgDesc.text: A mysterious type of ancient moon energy that has similar effects to kuuvahki. It can change how objects may be acted upon. Characters who absorb an object filled with Archaeolune Energy will enter the Moonvein Suffusion state.
Moonvein Suffusion will make your body feel lighter and <color=#ffe04b>increase your jump height. You can also use Archaeolune Ripples while jumping.</color>

Tap <color=#ffe04b>Attack</color> to unleash Archaeolune Ripples. Tap to cast it on the spot, and <color=#ffe04b>hold to aim and unleash. Tap again</color> after firing to detonate the Ripples and inflict damage on objects in the explosion AoE. This will also <color=#ffe04b>affect the gravity acting on affected objects</color> that are in the Moonvein Suffusion state. To exit the state, tap the Elemental Burst button.
